audit.method: Read only the saved rational laws; verify support, nonnegative weights, total mass, and moments m1=p and m2=q exactly; form kernels with n4_vertical.avg_direct; convert to gmpy2.mpq; propagate 50 model steps; sum nonabsorbing mass directly. No optimization or random search.

probe_float_headline.consequence: The float headline is not itself a certified bound. The exact rational pair and its downward decimal floor are the auditable bound.

cross_n_findings.reason: For n>=5 these are two feasible attained laws, not certified class extrema. Increasing attained lower bounds through n=6 cannot establish monotonicity of the unknown whole-class regret.
cross_n_findings.saturation_interpretation: The saved witnesses show high absolute persistence and a narrowing negative witness after n=6 at this one parameter setting. They do not identify saturation as the unique cause, locate a general saturation threshold, or imply that the positive side or whole compatible class narrows.

search_pipeline_audit.rationalisation_rule: rationalise drops every searched component with weight <=1e-7, rounds retained atoms, and solves new exact weights; its result can therefore be a nearby different law rather than an exact certificate for the floating candidate.
search_pipeline_audit.selector_mismatch_risk: main chooses L and U from each float search winner plus Glo and Ghi, but exact_reevaluation serializes only rationalisations of the float search winners. It does not explicitly exact-check which candidate supplied each headline L or U.
search_pipeline_audit.concrete_consequence_here: All twelve saved rationalisations are feasible and reproduce the displayed exact-reevaluation floats. Their exact pair regrets are slightly below the float regret headlines, so those headlines must not be used as rigorous lower bounds. The exact fractions or recorded downward floors are safe.
